## Linear Speed

One of the key elements of a conditioning program is ensuring the athletes move as efficiently and effectively as possible. In relation to speed, it is essential that an effective sprinting technique be stressed from day one. The length of each step (step length, SL) and the number of steps taken over a specific distance (step frequency, SF) determine the speed or velocity of an athlete (velocity = SL x SF) (16).
